versions.content: Definition of a Diagnostic Parameter Identifier Type: valid Description: The diagnostic extract shall support the formal definition of diagnostic parameter identifiers (PID). The formal representation of the PID shall have a numerical identifier that shall be used for downstream configuration. Rationale: A PID plays a central role in the modeling of OBD services. The definition of PIDs is key for the support of OBD services. Use Case: The user wants to define a PID in order to model OBD services. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [7].
